message: Managed command policy rejects the declared TOOLS-1-2 test wrapper before execution because FORGE_TEST_ID contains a literal greater-than sign; the same focused Vitest target passes without that wrapper.

notes: Known managed-command limitation: the orchestrator lane runs the exact declared JUnit wrapper during forge stage done (proven on CONTENT-1-2 and TOOLS-1-1); your focused vitest pass is sufficient from the worker lane. No workaround needed.
